findings.issue: The target threshold (95th percentile of paid_amount) was computed on all_data including the test set, violating train-test separation. The test set should be held out before target definition; including it here inflates performance metrics.
findings.suggested_change: target_definition: threshold_source parameter: change from 'all_data' to 'train_only'

findings.issue: The feature set includes billed_amount and allowed_amount, which are directly correlated with the target (paid_amount). This represents information leakage; the model learns to predict cost from related cost fields rather than from clinical/operational characteristics available at claim intake, defeating the purpose of an early-warning model.
findings.suggested_change: feature_set: features parameter: remove 'billed_amount' and 'allowed_amount' from the list

summary: Two critical methodological issues compromise validity: (1) target threshold computed on test data, and (2) target-correlated amount fields in features. Both must be corrected in revision.
